name: Line chart
purpose: A trend over time: a line draws through the values, with the point that matters called out.
use_when: 3-8 values from the source in time order (months, years, weeks, sessions)
avoid_when: numbers not in the source: never invent data

unit.desc: Unit for values: a suffix like '%', 'h', ' min', or a currency symbol ('$', '€'), which goes in front

highlight.desc: Index of the point to call out (default: the last)

line.desc: A line with a dot on each value

area.desc: The line with the area beneath it filled

example.headline: Questions to the help desk fell by half
example.note: Help desk tickets from new staff, per month.

example_beats.say: Since the new onboarding started, questions to the help desk have fallen month after month.
By June they were down by half.
